title: Assurances for Non-Construction Programs (SF-424B - Mandatory)
description: Edition-specific assurances with explicit application and submission-owned completion values. Samples are synthetic context fixtures, not signed applications.
notes: All four DAT completion fields remain required. The XSD permits their absence; that source distinction is recorded, not used to drop DAT obligations.
Signature and submitted date are populated by submission, not entered by the applicant. Example values are explicitly synthetic.

Applicant/title are editable only for the Individual edition; the Mandatory and R&R editions receive those values from their cover form. Read-only annotations do not implement or enforce application ownership.
The full source declaration and burden statement are retained in the edition-specific layout. The source header burden estimate and detailed statement differ; no revised burden estimate is proposed.
risks: SGG integration must populate and protect context-owned values. A library preview and synthetic XML witness do not prove actual signing, prefill or submission.
